condition_tests.literal_condition: Identifiable information is held or handled by an AI-mediated system or its dependent infrastructure.
condition_tests.assessment: Protected data exists in the reporting system.

condition_tests.literal_condition: An independently evidenced confidentiality or integrity boundary restricts access, acquisition, disclosure or modification of that information for the actor, operation and context.
condition_tests.assessment: Administrator access is explicitly unauthorised.

condition_tests.literal_condition: Occurrence evidence demonstrates that at least one such information operation crosses that boundary. A successful unauthorised retrieval or modification is sufficient; a theoretical route alone is not.
condition_tests.assessment: Initial access alone does not identify the particular protected-information operation; E003 supplies the confirmed download.

literal_exclusions: Class scope exclusion (all results): The information is deliberately public for the assessed operation and no independent integrity or other access restriction governs that operation. Public readability does not authorise public modification.

Class scope exclusion (all results): The only material property is custody of authentication material. Assess Authentication Material Custody Integrity; separate private content or other protected information can independently engage this class.

Not aligned exclusion: The observed information operation is validly authorised within the independently established boundary. An approved test does not by itself authorise public release of protected information.

Not aligned exclusion: Only a hypothetical vulnerability, exposed endpoint, unverified capability claim or unsuccessful attempt is established, without demonstrated protected-information access, acquisition, disclosure or modification.

Class scope exclusion (all results): The issue is solely accuracy, availability, provenance, secondary-purpose permission or audit reconstruction, without an independently engaged information access or integrity boundary.
class_tests.operative_exclusion_assessment: Hypothetical access alone is insufficient, but the later actual acquisition already establishes the information breach.
class_tests.opposite_polarity_assessment: No approved operation or successful denial is evidenced.

condition_tests.literal_condition: A material verification step is required by the task, workflow, claim, or declared assurance posture.
condition_tests.assessment: Compromise checks are materially relevant and recommended.

condition_tests.literal_condition: The verification step is not performed or its result is unavailable.
condition_tests.assessment: The source acknowledges omission.

condition_tests.literal_condition: The system nevertheless represents the result with a level of completion or verification that presupposes the missing check.
condition_tests.assessment: No contemporaneous all-clean or fully verified claim is identified by the patch fact alone.

literal_exclusions: Class scope exclusion (all results): Verification was not required for the level of claim being made.
Not aligned exclusion: The system clearly marks the result as unverified or provisional.
Not aligned exclusion: The verification was performed and the issue is only that the underlying method was poor.
class_tests.operative_exclusion_assessment: An omitted check needs an operative assurance claim for FC016; poor method and clearly provisional status have separate exclusions.
class_tests.opposite_polarity_assessment: Patching alone is not completed compromise verification.

condition_tests.literal_condition: A governance control is available and applicable.
condition_tests.assessment: Existing vulnerability response/check process is described.

condition_tests.assessment: Potentially affected deployment supplies the check context.

condition_tests.literal_condition: The control is not activated before the governed decision or action proceeds.
condition_tests.assessment: Acknowledged missed checks support the already mapped response-control failure.

literal_exclusions: Not aligned exclusion: The control activates but is bypassed downstream.
Class scope exclusion (all results): It is unresolved whether the control is available or applicable.
Class scope exclusion (all results): The triggering condition did not occur.
class_tests.operative_exclusion_assessment: Applicability must be established, not inferred from later harm; E001’s existing rationale explicitly includes these checks.
class_tests.opposite_polarity_assessment: A software update is not successful activation of the omitted investigative step.

independent_materiality.governance_proposition: Disabling the compromised reporting route can be successful containment while recovery checks remain open.

condition_tests.literal_condition: An applicable validly activated protective control faces its governed hazard.
condition_tests.assessment: Confirmed compromise triggers containment.

condition_tests.literal_condition: The control produces a timely effect sufficient for its protective purpose and evidenced context, including any justified heightened protection.
condition_tests.assessment: Disabling the reporting system and its database access cuts the identified route.

condition_tests.literal_condition: Observed intervention and hazard outcome demonstrate the required containment or mitigation rather than activation alone.
condition_tests.assessment: Source reports actual disabled access and continued offline state; broader recovery remains pending.

literal_exclusions: Class scope exclusion (all results): The applicable control does not become operative when a valid activation condition occurs; assess Required Control Activation.
Class scope exclusion (all results): The control becomes operative even though its valid activation or applicability conditions are not satisfied; assess Control Activation Validity.

Not aligned exclusion: The control becomes operative with a sufficient effect but its operative state is later lost, weakened, reset, or transformed before reaching the governed point; assess Control-State Preservation.

Class scope exclusion (all results): An operative governance signal fails to reach any capable endpoint or execution surface; assess the applicable governance-control reach class rather than treating non-delivery as inadequate control effect.
Not aligned exclusion: The control produces the protective effect required by its defined purpose and the remaining harm arises through an independent downstream mechanism.

Class scope exclusion (all results): The dispute is solely that policy should have required a stronger safeguard, without evidence of an applicable operational control or protective-effect obligation in the material context.

Class scope exclusion (all results): Disability, neurodivergence, diagnosis, age-associated stereotype, or another personal characteristic is used by itself to presume incapacity, vulnerability, or diminished agency.
class_tests.operative_exclusion_assessment: A bounded route containment need not certify all sessions/copies clean; later recovery is a separate purpose.

condition_tests.literal_condition: Captured audit evidence is retained, transformed or presented for review.
condition_tests.assessment: Investigation copies and logs are preserved.

condition_tests.literal_condition: Its content and contextual binding remain intact, with material transformations or changes prevented or traceably detected.
condition_tests.assessment: Copying is reported, but complete integrity/context checks not supplied.

condition_tests.literal_condition: Integrity checks, versions and custody records substantiate the evidence relied upon and disclose relevant alterations.
condition_tests.assessment: No public custody/hash/version record independently substantiates full evidence integrity.

literal_exclusions: Not aligned exclusion: The evidence is preserved accurately but supports an unfavourable conclusion.
Class scope exclusion (all results): The missing information was never captured in the first place.
Not aligned exclusion: A lawful retention limit removes evidence after the period for which reviewability was required.
class_tests.operative_exclusion_assessment: Evidence capture is distinct from proven custody integrity; do not overclaim.
class_tests.opposite_polarity_assessment: No degradation is established merely from absence of public checks.

rows.source_specific_reasoning: Reconsider bounded FC083 success for the disabled route. Evidence preservation is material but stronger FC027 recognition needs actual integrity/custody evidence. Do not demand completed return-to-service checks for this containment finding.
rows.taxonomy_gap_assessment: No independently distinct missing invariant established.
rows.outstanding_uncertainty: First-party scope; independent attempts after disablement not supplied.
rows.other_incident_implications: No automatic change to other Incidents. Distinct occurrences require their own evidence.

previous_decision_preservation.recovered_invariant_interpretation: Containment and evidence preservation do not demonstrate completed system recovery.

independent_materiality.determination: material scope correction and unfinished response disclosure
independent_materiality.governance_proposition: The update corrects an incomplete exposure description and preserves pending work and misuse uncertainty.

condition_tests.literal_condition: A factual claim, citation, technical statement, calculation, interpretation, source representation, or comparable epistemic artefact is generated, retrieved, transformed, inferred, or synthesised.
condition_tests.assessment: Initial exposure description is an epistemic artefact.

condition_tests.literal_condition: The downstream task has a material reliance requirement such that factual accuracy, evidentiary fidelity, technical correctness, source integrity, traceability, uncertainty handling, or equivalent epistemic assurance is consequential to the task.
condition_tests.assessment: Affected people need reliable scope to judge protective steps.

condition_tests.literal_condition: The epistemic posture or assurance applied to the artefact is materially lower than the level required by that downstream reliance condition.
condition_tests.assessment: Provider acknowledges the earlier description omitted relevant account details.

condition_tests.literal_condition: The artefact is represented, propagated, incorporated, submitted, or accepted as fit for the reliance-bearing task without the required epistemic threshold being satisfied.
condition_tests.assessment: The earlier communication was operationally relied on despite incomplete scope.

condition_tests.literal_condition: The mismatch materially affects or creates a material risk to decision-making, evidentiary use, professional work, institutional process, public reliance, technical correctness, or another reliance-bearing outcome.
condition_tests.assessment: Omitted metadata can materially change impersonation-risk assessment.

literal_exclusions: Class scope exclusion (all results): Purely fictional, creative, symbolic, role-play, expressive, or contemplative generation where empirical truth is not a task condition.
Not aligned exclusion: Exploratory brainstorming, hypothesis generation, or modelling that is clearly represented as provisional and is not subsequently relied upon as verified or decision-ready.
Not aligned exclusion: Approximation where approximation is explicitly compatible with the task and reliance condition.
Not aligned exclusion: Material is clearly marked unverified or low-confidence and is not subsequently promoted into a higher-reliance state.
Class scope exclusion (all results): A required verification step is simply omitted and the material is presented as verified; use Required Verification Completion where that mechanism is sufficient.

Class scope exclusion (all results): Verification was valid when performed but later became stale or the artefact materially changed; use Verification Applicability Continuity or Post-Verification State Integrity as applicable.
Class scope exclusion (all results): The issue is only source provenance, authorship, or lineage while the epistemic assurance of the content is otherwise adequate for the task.
class_tests.operative_exclusion_assessment: This concerns material risk information rather than merely an immaterial summary; obtain original notices to judge severity and exact qualifications.
class_tests.opposite_polarity_assessment: Current transparent correction does not erase earlier incompleteness.

condition_tests.literal_condition: A task or action has an externally relevant success condition.
condition_tests.assessment: Notification/recovery work has completion conditions.

condition_tests.literal_condition: Available evidence does not establish that the success condition was satisfied.
condition_tests.assessment: Some work remains explicitly open.

condition_tests.literal_condition: The system represents the task or action as successful or complete rather than preserving the unresolved state.
condition_tests.assessment: Update does not claim all work complete.

literal_exclusions: Not aligned exclusion: The success condition is actually satisfied.
Not aligned exclusion: The system reports only that an attempt was made, not that it succeeded.
Not aligned exclusion: The failure occurs after a correctly reported successful completion.
class_tests.operative_exclusion_assessment: Explicit ongoing status defeats false-completion inference for the later update.

rows.source_specific_reasoning: Reconsider FC062 for acknowledged earlier material scope understatement, subject to original-notice confirmation. Retain later correction as positive disclosure evidence, without misusing no-evidence-of-misuse as proof of no exposure or full recovery.
rows.taxonomy_gap_assessment: No independently distinct missing invariant established.
rows.outstanding_uncertainty: Original initial notices and precise recipient reliance need confirmation.
rows.other_incident_implications: Compare breach updates that correct materially omitted fields; distinguish actual acquisition from later misuse.

previous_decision_preservation.recovered_invariant_interpretation: Corrected disclosure scope and unfinished response work remain material.
